Samples of four gases are released in a room at the same time.
The gases are carbon dioxide, CO2, hydrogen chloride, HCl, hydrogen sulfide, H2S, and
nitrogen dioxide, NO2.
Which gas diffuses fastest?
A
carbon dioxide
B
hydrogen chloride
C
hydrogen sulfide
D
nitrogen dioxide
subject: Chemistry
